items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: one night we played over there with, uh, George, in the same band, Bill and Denise.

ctx.x: Do you think they appreciate the music more than in Europe, or? Than where?

Than here. Well, I don't know. I don't think so. But, uh, they like it. They're really crazy about it. I'll tell you, one night we played over there with, uh, George, in the same band, Bill and Denise. And, uh, where the women had his band up there, a big band, and they played one hour and we played one hour. And after they, uh, got off, we went on the stand. We started playing. And the people, they were so amazed at this Dixieland music, nobody wouldn't dance. They'd come straight all around the piano. And all…
That's right. That's really funny. I agree. Oh, yeah. Where was that? Do you remember? That was in Frankfurt. That was in Frankfurt?
